rationale: The exact L4 candidate passed 35 Rust tests per run across two deterministic runs, all seven bounded sandbox invariants, non-vacuous activation observation, exact explicit teardown, cleanup, selected-dependency currentness, and mutation probes while retaining a non-live, credential-free, network-free, production-data-free, no-external-effect boundary.
